title: RTEC Employee Handbook archive copies printed July 15, 2019 and July 19, 2021

sources.archive_context: Archived attachment on 2020-01-02; corresponding message body contained no substantive content.
Archived attachment on 2020-01-03; corresponding position-level email says ?Please post on website.? This documents a posting request, not proof of completion.
Archived attachment on 2021-10-01; corresponding position-level email says the revised handbook should replace the website copy. This documents a replacement instruction, not proof of completion.

review.unresolved_revision_state: The 2021 source is labelled revised in its email context but retains unaccepted Word tracked revisions. Its redline is preserved as-is; no accepted/rejected view is asserted as authoritative.
2021_policy_change_topics_observed: personal/sick leave statement regarding a physician note after the third consecutive day
attendance point thresholds/removal/expiration and unpaid no-point days
fulltext_cautions: The DOCX is authoritative for layout and automatic numbering.
Tracked changes in the 2021 DOCX must be reviewed in Word before treating any individual clause as adopted.
No effective date has been established.
These pre-April-2026 documents are RTEC organizational history, not the user?s personal work history.
review.excluded_content: No raw email body, employee/applicant case record, personal timeline detail, or person-level dossier was stored.
review.content_review_status: Full text extracted for all three sources; document structure and version differences reviewed. Clause-by-clause review of every handbook provision remains in progress.
2019_copy_differences_observed: The Jan 3 copy changes several table-of-contents page references.
It changes funeral leave wording from the scheduled day of the funeral to the scheduled weekday of the funeral.
It adds work-related accident as an excused-absence category in the attendance policy.
It changes cafeteria guidance from exposed food to food and adds a food-handler-card requirement.
It adds conduct on or off the job that reflects unfavorably on RTEC to work rules.
It corrects recording/audio-tape wording in the vehicle/property notice and moves the employee-notes page after the receipt certificate.
2021_tracked_policy_edits_observed: Personal/sick leave: changes the physician-statement trigger wording to ?on the 3rd day of consecutive absence.?

Attendance: removes a no-fault characterization while retaining the attendance definition; updates physician-statement timing; revises point threshold from 10 to 6, point removal after 90 to 60 consecutive days, and partial-day threshold from 4 hours or less to less than 4 hours; adds three unpaid days with no points.
The extracted redline also contains small wording edits around the offense/point table. These edits are not treated as adopted policy because tracked changes remain unresolved.

relationships.note: Both display July 15, 2019, but have distinct hashes and content. The Jan 3 copy has specific text differences documented in README and paragraph diff.
The 2021 document is printed July 19, 2021; position-level correspondence says it should replace the website copy. Tracked changes remain unresolved, so no accepted final version is asserted.
A later complete March 2023 handbook archive is preserved separately.
A complete December 2025 handbook archive is preserved separately. Later source does not establish section-specific effective dates.
